## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, the DCO)
- [ ] Builds without warnings on Linux, Windows and macOS (CI)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a bug fix has a regression test
- [ ] A change to a file format adds a fixture and a migration
- [ ] New user-visible strings are translatable; new controls have an accessible name and a keyboard path
- [ ] A new dependency is justified below, and its licence is compatible with the GPL-3.0
- [ ] A change to the pipeline or the catalogue includes a performance run (say on which machine)
- [ ] A change to a format, the plugin API, the pipeline definition or the licence has an approved decision (D-xxx)
